d:
English translation + the textless images I created (for anyone looking to translate into other languages).

Rough translation of the description for this piece from the artist's pixiv page:
"A group of female students who get lost during a factory tour are transformed into robots. They attempt to find their way back to the designated tour route, but — unbeknownst to them — the conversion process is already underway. Ultimately, they are shipped out as finished products."

RAW:https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/142146200

The original artist doesn't have a Patreon or anything (that I could find, though he does commissions on skeb:https://skeb.jp/@hokan185), but it you enjoyed this work, please consider dropping a like on the pixiv page for the creator's original version and maybe give them a follow, as it will hopefully motivate them to create more works in the future.

As a final side note, I'd like to offer a brief apology to @VermillionFox162, who has released translations for many of 581's other works, in case they were already working on a translation for this piece. It's not my intention to step on anyone else's toes, but there have been times when its taken a while for their translations to release, and I wanted to get this out there for any English-speaking fans of 581 who liked the visuals of this piece as much as I did and were hoping for a way to read the text (and, admittedly, to get out in front of any AI translators who might have had eyes on this piece). If @VermillionFox162 would like to release their own version of this story using my translation but with their own text fonts so that it is consistent with their other translations, then I give my permission for them to do so (though I won't be removing this gallery as I don't want my own efforts to go to waste lol). Additionally, I want to make clear that I have no plans to translate any of 581's other untranslated works at this time, so please don't take this release as a challenge or a sign that I have ambitions beyond what you see here. This was just a case of me finding a short manga about girls getting turned into robo-sex dolls that I really liked, choosing to translate it for myself, and deciding to share that translation with anyone else who might be interested.
n: [Doujinshi] [581] Mujikakuna Sekusaroido Robot e no Henshin | Oblivious Transformation into Sexaroid Robots [English + Text Cleaned] [Optitron]
